name: Agent identity inventory and accountable ownership
fix: Assign a distinct workload identity and accountable owner to every agent; remove shared privileged identities.

name: Bounded user-to-agent delegation
fix: Bind delegated authority to the initiating user, agent, tenant, permitted actions and expiry.

name: Tool, resource and tenant authorization
fix: Enforce identity, tenant, tool and object authorization outside the model, including on downstream APIs.

name: Human approval binding and replay protection
fix: Bind a single-use approval to the exact identity, tool, arguments, policy version and expiry; separate requester and approver.

name: Agent runtime isolation and egress restrictions
fix: Sandbox agent runtimes with scoped filesystem, network and execution permissions; test the actual boundaries.

name: Untrusted prompt and tool-output injection resistance
fix: Treat prompts, retrieved documents, tool descriptions and outputs as untrusted; constrain action execution independently of the model.

name: Agent data access and exfiltration boundaries
fix: Restrict data and destinations, redact secrets and test synthetic exfiltration canaries.

name: Agent action attribution and audit continuity
fix: Correlate user, agent, tenant, tool, policy decision, approval and result without recording credentials.

name: Revocation, kill switch and execution budgets
fix: Enforce revocation and kill switches before each action; apply durable per-identity execution budgets.

name: MCP token validation and downstream credential separation
fix: Validate issuer, audience, expiry and required scopes; use separate downstream credentials, never inbound token passthrough.

name: MCP client consent and redirect protections
fix: Bind consent to the specific client and scopes; use exact redirects and single-use expiring OAuth state.

name: MCP session binding and replay resistance
fix: Authorize each request independently; bind any session to its verified identity and invalidate revoked sessions.

name: Local MCP executable trust and secret isolation
fix: Approve and pin local MCP executables, isolate process permissions and pass only the minimum required environment credentials.
